Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.s1Body: Healed ("we", "us", or "our") operates the healedapp.net website and the Healed mobile application (together, the "Service"). This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have. By using the Service, you agree to the collection and use of information as described here.
Privacy.s2Intro: We currently collect information you voluntarily provide to us, including:
Privacy.s2Item1Rest: — when you join our waitlist or subscribe to updates via the website.
Privacy.s2Item2Bold: Name, email address, and message content
Privacy.s2Item2Rest: — when you submit the support and feedback form.
Privacy.s2Outro: We do not currently require account creation, and we do not collect payment information, health records, or sensitive personal data through this website.
Privacy.s3Item1: To notify you when early access to the Healed app becomes available.
Privacy.s3Item2: To respond to support requests and feedback you submit.
Privacy.s3Item3: To send occasional product updates related to Healed.
Privacy.s3Item4: To improve and monitor the performance of our website.
Privacy.s3Outro: We do not sell your personal information to third parties.
Privacy.s4Intro: We use the following third-party services to operate the Service:
Privacy.s4Item1Rest: — to deliver support and feedback notifications to our team.
Privacy.s4Item2Rest: — to store waitlist and subscription email addresses.
Privacy.s4Outro: These providers process data on our behalf and are bound by their own privacy and security practices.
Privacy.s5Body: We retain the information you provide for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy, or until you request deletion.
Privacy.s6BodyBefore: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information at any time by contacting us at
Privacy.s6BodyAfter: . You may also unsubscribe from email updates at any time.
Privacy.s7Body: The Service is not directed to individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
Privacy.s8Body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated "Last updated" date.
Privacy.s9BodyBefore: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at

By accessing or using the Service, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the Service.
Terms.s2Body: Healed is a mobile application currently in development, designed to help users connect with a verified sobriety squad on their recovery journey. This website provides information about Healed, a waitlist for early access, and a way to contact us for support or feedback. The Healed mobile application is not yet publicly available.
Terms.s3Body: Joining the waitlist does not guarantee access to the Healed application, a specific release date, or any particular features. We may contact you by email regarding early access, product updates, or related announcements.
Terms.s4Body: Healed is intended to support community and accountability during recovery. It is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, or emergency services.
